name: citrus_engine_external_event_notify_to_broadcast_ms
description: DISTRIBUTION of `external_event.applied.notifyToBroadcastMs` (server/src/draft/LobbyManager.ts): Postgres NOTIFY received -> event applied -> uWS broadcast dispatched, for events written by another process. Today every MANUAL pick takes this path (HTTP route draftV2Pick.ts -> submit_pick_v2 -> NOTIFY -> engine), so with label eventType=pick this is the server-side half of the Mandate's manual-pick / fanout targets (fanout p95 <= 200 ms). Lines without the field (no notification timestamp) are excluded. Value is regex-extracted from the raw JSON line because the gcplogs driver does not parse it (see README). Managed by infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-monitoring.sh.
filter: (jsonPayload.container.metadata.app="citrus-draft-engine" OR labels.app="citrus-draft-engine") AND (jsonPayload.event="external_event.applied" OR jsonPayload.message:"\"event\":\"external_event.applied\"") AND (jsonPayload.notifyToBroadcastMs:* OR jsonPayload.message:"\"notifyToBroadcastMs\":")

labels.description: draft_events.event_type of the applied event (pick, draft_paused, auction_bid_placed, ...). `pick` = a manual pick submitted over HTTP.
Docker label `environment` forwarded by the gcplogs driver (production / staging).
